title: Build an Aether portal
description: Open a gateway to the Aether from the Overworld with a glowstone frame and a bucket of water.

materials.label: Glowstone
materials.description: Add 4 more blocks to fill the optional corners.

steps.title: Stand up a glowstone frame
steps.text: Make a vertical rectangle four blocks wide and five blocks tall, with a two-by-three opening inside. The four corner blocks are optional.

figure.alt: Front view of the ten Glowstone frame blocks with optional corners. Pour the Water Bucket into the two-by-three opening.

steps.title: Pour water into the opening
steps.text: Use the Water Bucket inside the frame against the lower glowstone. When the opening fills with the portal, walk through. Use the portal on the other side to return.

tips.title: The water flows out
tips.text: Confirm you used full Glowstone blocks, the inner opening is clear, and the frame stands upright in the Overworld. Recheck the bottom and top rows and both side columns.
